resources.title: C Interfaces and Implementations: Techniques for Creating Reusable Software

inspection.method: Held edition verification and bounded PDF reading; author-hosted chapter inspected
inspection.scope: Public Chapter 3 (Atoms) and held arena PDF pages 105–109, 114–118; front matter and author page. Enhancement inspection: Held PDF pages 30–40, printed pp.15–25; Chapter 2 headings and substantive interfaces/implementation, opaque pointer and client-contract text.
inspection.limits: Historical C idioms require modernization. Atom exercise 3.4 deliberately allows undefined behavior; it is critique material. Arena alignment, integer overflow, null-pointer arithmetic, global state and lifetime claims need contemporary review. Not a modern safety oracle. Arithmetic examples describe historical pre-C99 division rules; C17 division is toward zero. Use the contract/representation mechanism, not old arithmetic behavior or complete copied implementation.
